title: Camp Runner
identity: Adult man about24, lean angular face, cropped dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, warm olive skin and brown eyes. Clear right-facing THREE-QUARTER face, eyes focused beyond the right of the viewer.
action: A dusty Macedonian military camp with canvas tents, distant pikes, low mountains and dawn smoke. The runner has just stopped at a tent rope, one hand cradling a small rolled dispatch bound with a plain red cord, the other hand holding the strap of a small leather message satchel. The scene conveys dependable speed and alertness. The runner wears a plain knee-length off-white linen tunic, simple belt and faded rust-red shoulder cloth, no armour or sword.

title: Lyceum Attendant
identity: Adult man about35 with a broad thoughtful face, dark close-cropped curls, a short square beard, weathered olive complexion and grey-brown eyes. FRONTAL face with both eyes clearly visible, looking up briefly from preparing the bench.
action: An Athenian shaded portico prepared for a modest lesson, shelves and a plane tree in the background. The attendant carefully places a rolled papyrus and a wooden wax tablet on a worn bench while scholars gather in the distant shade. One hand sets down the tablet by its edge; the other carries the single scroll. Plain sand-coloured linen chiton and a faded indigo shoulder wrap, no scholar crown or luxury.

title: Geometry Apprentice
identity: Adult man about27, narrow face, short tightly curled black hair, sparse moustache and short chin beard, deep olive skin and focused dark eyes. Clear left-facing THREE-QUARTER face looking slightly down at the circle, with the near pupil readable.
action: A modest Alexandrian teaching court, pale stone columns and baskets of papyrus in soft distance. The apprentice uses a small plain wooden two-legged compass to inscribe one clean circle on a wax-covered board resting flat on a table. One hand naturally grips the compass at its hinge; the other steadies the board near its far edge. The circle and tool contact are clear and simple, no advanced astronomical apparatus. Plain oatmeal linen chiton with a muted green shoulder cloth.

title: Deckhand of Massalia
identity: Adult man about38, weathered long face, short sandy-brown hair and salt-streaked short beard, sunburnt fair skin and clear blue-grey eyes. Clear left-facing THREE-QUARTER face looking toward shore, visible pupils.
action: The deck of a fourth-centuryBCE Mediterranean merchant vessel leaving Massalia, rough timber railing, furled linen sail, low sea swell and pale coastline in the distance. The deckhand carefully coils thick natural-fibre rope on the deck: one hand guides a rope loop, the other holds the standing length. Hands separated and easy to trace. Plain weathered blue-grey knee-length tunic with a simple rope belt, bare forearms and a faded brown shoulder cloth.

title: Stagehand
identity: Adult man about29, round full face, thick dark wavy hair at ear length, neatly trimmed moustache, warm olive skin and hazel eyes. FRONTAL face with both eyes clearly visible as he briefly looks up from the prop.
action: Backstage at an early Hellenistic Greek theatre, a timber prop table, folded simple costumes, distant stone seating glimpsed between curtains. The stagehand sets down a single natural pale terracotta comic theatre mask on the table with one hand supporting each side, fingers outside the eye holes. It is a prop with no human head inside. A basket of props rests nearby, no modern stage machinery. Plain unbleached linen tunic and muted wine-brown shawl, no ornate actor costume.
